standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue-if-th.npc: You new here? I don't recognise you.
Well, [Vampyre name], welcome to the essence mine.
That's right. Here, we use the slaves to mine daeyalt essence.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue-if-th.player: Daeyalt essence? Is that connected to daeyalt ore?

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue-if-th.npc: Indeed it is. Daeyalt ore is a weaker form of daeyalt essence. It still has uses, hence why we have the slaves mine it. The essence here is far more powerful though.
They say that an object of great power was once stored in this very cave. Apparently, the presence of this object created the daeyalt deposits.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue-if-th.player: I see. What is the daeyalt used for?

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue-if-th.npc: Its main use is as a key component in the vampyrification process. There's other uses though. It can be used to create runes, for example.
The essence mined by the slaves is reserved. If you want some, you'll have to mine your own.
If you do choose to mine the deposits, you should know that the daeyalt shards you'll get are useless on their own. They'll need converting into essence to be used.
Luckily for you, I can provide that service.

If the player is not an Ultimate Ironman:

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue-if-th.npc: Oh, one other thing. The daeyalt almost seems to have a mind of its own. Only one deposit will be active at a time. You'll need to pay attention to which one it is.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue-if-th.player: I see. I'll bear that in mind.
